subproblem.title: Mass of the restriction current: M_W(T⌞A) = μ(W ∩ A) (Simon 6.2.8–2.9, R3)
subproblem.statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P, v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) k with x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) μ-integrable for every ω ∈ D^k(U), μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for all x, α, x ↦ v(x)(α) Borel for every α, and for μ-a.e. x some α with covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 and v(x)(α) = 1. Then for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P, every S ∈ D_k(U) with S(ω) = ∫_A v(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ D^k(U), and every open W ⊆ U, M_W(S) = μ(W ∩ A) in [0, ∞].
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, Measurable (fun x => v x α)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ v x α = 1) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → S.massOn W = μ (W ∩ A)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Conventions. ℝ^P = Eucl P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) with standard basis b_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i (i ∈ Fin P). A k-covector is α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) k (a continuous alternating k-linear map ℝ^P → ℝ) with operator norm ‖α‖; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing} α(b_{I(0)},…,b_{I(k−1)})²)^{1/2}. A k-vector is w ∈ NVector (Eucl P) k, a continuous linear functional on k-covectors. D^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth, compactly supported forms with tsupport ⊆ U), D_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k, M_W(T) = T.massOn W = sup{ENNReal.ofReal(T(ω)) : ω ∈ D^k(U), tsupport ω ⊆ W, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 ∀x} (massAdmissibleOn). CF(U) := {φ : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) k : φ continuous, HasCompactSupport φ, tsupport φ ⊆ U}. All measures are Borel measures on ℝ^P; ∫_A f dμ means ∫ x in A, f x ∂μ (integral for μ.restrict A). Source: Simon, Introduction to GMT, Ch. 6, 2.7–2.9 (pp. 136–137), with Ch. 1, 4.14 (Riesz) and 1.17 (Lusin); this argument is extracted from the parent proof of slicing_mass_representation (its steps are cited as P1–P7).

This is step P6 of the parent proof: the upper bound directly, the lower bound from the sibling theorems smr_exists_unit_form_gt and smr_ofReal_integral_le_massOn.

1. (Upper bound.) Let ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U k W, i.e. ω ∈ D^k(U), tsupport ω ⊆ W and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. For every x, |v(x)(ω(x))| ≤ |ω(x)| ≤ 1, and if x ∉ tsupport ω then ω(x) = 0 and v(x)(ω(x)) = 0; hence ‖v(x)(ω(x))‖ₑ ≤ 1_{tsupport ω}(x). Using ENNReal.ofReal(t) ≤ ‖t‖ₑ for real t and ‖∫ f dν‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ ‖f‖ₑ dν (enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm, valid for every f), ENNReal.ofReal(S(ω)) ≤ ∫⁻ ‖v(x)(ω(x))‖ₑ d(μ⌞A) ≤ ∫⁻ 1_{tsupport ω} d(μ⌞A) = μ(tsupport ω ∩ A) ≤ μ(W ∩ A) (tsupport ω is closed, hence Borel, and contained in W). Since M_W(S) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(S(ω)) over such ω, M_W(S) ≤ μ(W ∩ A).
2. (Lower bound.) Let c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < μ(W ∩ A). By smr_exists_unit_form_gt (hypotheses: μ finite on compact subsets of U, |v(x)(α)| ≤ |α|, x ↦ v(x)(α) Borel, the a.e. unit witnesses, A Borel, W open ⊆ U) there is a continuous φ with compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ W, |φ(x)| ≤ 1 for all x and c < ENNReal.ofReal(∫_A v(x)(φ(x)) dμ). By smr_ofReal_integral_le_massOn (hypotheses: test-form integrability, μ finite on compact subsets of U, |v(x)(α)| ≤ |α|, the formula for S, W open ⊆ U, and these properties of φ), ENNReal.ofReal(∫_A v(x)(φ(x)) dμ) ≤ M_W(S). Hence c < M_W(S). As c < μ(W ∩ A) was arbitrary, μ(W ∩ A) ≤ M_W(S) (le_of_forall_lt).
3. (Conclusion.) By steps 1 and 2, M_W(S) = μ(W ∩ A) in [0, ∞]. ∎
proof_key_steps: Upper bound: for admissible ω, |v(ω)| ≤ 1_{tsupport ω}, so ofReal(S(ω)) ≤ μ(tsupport ω ∩ A) ≤ μ(W ∩ A); take the supremum.
Lower bound: for c < μ(W ∩ A), smr_exists_unit_form_gt gives a continuous unit form φ supported in W with c < ofReal(∫_A v(φ) dμ).
smr_ofReal_integral_le_massOn gives ofReal(∫_A v(φ) dμ) ≤ M_W(S); hence μ(W ∩ A) ≤ M_W(S) and equality.

audit.reason: The statement matches, including every representing S and arbitrary open W contained in U. The indicator estimate proves the supremum upper bound. The two declared dependencies give the lower bound for every c < μ(W ∩ A), including infinite mass. No representation uniqueness or parent theorem is assumed.
